tips.text: Set matchmaking to Solo before entering Pontis Tower to fly your own Railjack; squads always get a loaner.
Shoot every green target in the Orowyrm or Ramsled flight and stay at the controls; the loot is personal and an AFK run throws it away.
Buy a missing part from Hunhow the moment you reach 90 Talents instead of waiting for the drop.
Run it solo; the missions are short, and public squads bring loaner ships and teammates who ignore objectives.
Run Steel Path once you can; it pays about half again as many Talents and triples the flight bonus.
Pick whichever boss fight you like better: the Kuva Wytch always has a Sister of Parvos first, Scoria's Angel a Comet Shredder Captain.
Expect duplicate blueprints; they sell for credits and never turn into Talents.
Relog if you get the same blueprint run after run; the reward table can stick.
Ignore a Mission Failed screen after the boss dies; the rewards still arrive.
Bring armor strip or a buff dispel for the Sister of Parvos and her Warding Halo.
Bring homing weapons or a glaive amp alt-fire to clear the big enemy rooms fast.
Toggle boost, then tap descend to ram the asteroid and cargo ship in one hit each and save 20 to 30 seconds.
Start each 12-hour part build as soon as its blueprint drops, since the main build then takes 3 days.
Expect the frame parts in about an hour of runs; the shop and side weapons are what grind.
Expect the missions to stay fun for only 5 to 10 runs; many players do the minimum and never return.
